title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into managed-lookup audit data. When another user with access to the Managed Lookups Audit dashboard selects an affected row, Splunk may execute attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands with the permissions of the selecting user. This occurs because the dashboard does not properly escape audit data before using it in drilldown searches, potentially allowing unauthorized data access and modification.
